articleTitle: Research of Hybrid Rectifier with LCL Filter
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE International Conference of Safety Produce Informatization (IICSPI)
abstract: In order to restrain the current ripple in grid side of hybrid rectifier and the obvious current distortion caused by the current mutation in grid side of Vienna rectifier, an improved method that replace the L filter in gird side of Vienna rectifier and single switch three-phase boost rectifier (SSTPBR) with LCL filter is proposed in this paper. Passivity-based controllers of Vienna rectifier and SSTPBR with LCL filter are built separately. A comparative performance between traditional and improved hybrid rectifier is carried out according to simulation, which verifies the correction and advance of improved hybrid rectifier with LCL filter.

articleTitle: The Special Φ40mm Tube Distributing Hole Drilling Equipment Used in Electrostatic Precipitator Design
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE International Conference of Safety Produce Informatization (IICSPI)
abstract: In order to realize the distribution hole of the radial-processing electrostatic precipitator tube with multiple drills simultaneously, a distributed drilling equipment of the pipe is developed, which can realize 10 holes processing simultaneously. Using SoildWorks software, three-dimensional solid modeling and virtual prototyping assembly are carried out for drilling mechanism, tool feed mechanism and transmission mechanism. The modal analysis of the spindle is carried out by using Ansys Workbench, the total deformation after the spindle vibration is obtained, and the rationality of the spindle design is verified. The PLC control system is used to realize the automation of machine tool machining. The results show that the special machine tool can meet the requirements of high efficiency and high-quality processing, and improve the economic benefit of the tube production.

articleTitle: The Design of A Computer Inspection and Management System for Multi-level Network
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE International Conference of Safety Produce Informatization (IICSPI)
abstract: The maturity of computer terminal inspection technology has led to a preliminary improvement in the capabilities of computer secrecy inspection in secret units. However, the development of informatization and the continuous increased secrecy situation have placed increasing demands on the secrecy inspection and supervision capabilities in those secret units. In view of the current boundary protection issues of computer terminal secrecy inspection systems in the multi-level deployment mode, and the analysis and use of inspection results can not reflect the implementation of the secrecy responsibilities of the secret personnel's entire career and the lack of coverage the entire life cycle of secrecy the inspections process such as application, approval, execution, notification and rectification, a multi-level computer terminal inspection management system has been designed. Through the establishment of a cross-domain exchange data platform, data security problems in secrecy inspection are solved. Though the establishment of secrecy inspection results analysis mechanisms based on people's careers, the secret units can trace implementation of the secrecy responsibility of secret personnel throughout their careers. By the informatization of the entire lifecycle process of the secrecy inspection process on the same platform, capabilities of the secrecy inspection and supervision can be enhanced effectively.

articleTitle: Exploration and Application of Sheet Metal Technology on Pit Package Repairing
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE International Conference of Safety Produce Informatization (IICSPI)
abstract: Automobile body always bumps, resulting in a large number of pit package damage to happen, which caused adverse impacts on production. The sheet metal repairing technology were used in automobile maintenance. The theoretical basis, common methods and tools for repairing were described at first. Then procedures and standards of repairing were studied. Based on the properties of materials and the basic knowledge of mechanics, the automobile door was repaired. Experiments showed that the repaired method is good, and the repaired doors met quality standards. Practices proved that the technology were applied to other parts of automobile body, and it achieved great economic and social benefits, also.

articleTitle: Hybrid Intelligent Algorithm for Solving Matrix Game with Fuzzy Variables
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE International Conference of Safety Produce Informatization (IICSPI)
abstract: In this paper, a two-person zero-sum matrix game in which the payoffs are characterized as fuzzy variables is provided and the game which is equivalence to an appropriate pair of fuzzy programming models is shown. Fuzzy simulation and particle swarm optimization are integrated to produce a hybrid intelligent algorithm for solving the programming models with fuzzy variables. Finally, a numerical example is provided to illustrate the effectiveness of the algorithm.

articleTitle: System Dynamical Simulation of Risk Perception for Enterprise Employee
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE International Conference of Safety Produce Informatization (IICSPI)
abstract: In order to explore the dynamic evolution of risk perception for enterprise employee, system dynamical model for employees' risk perception is established from three agents: enterprise organization, enterprise manager and employee. Vensim software is used to simulate the evolutionary rule of employee's risk perception. The results show that the trend of employee's risk perception will periodically rise and decline, and reach to a higher degree than before; the employee's risk perception will drop significantly by reducing the risk severity; when safety culture is increased, there will be a delay before rise; when the manager's safety concern and the safety supervision are increased, the employee's risk perception will increase, but the impact caused by manager's safety concern will be more obvious than safety supervision. These research results can provide a theoretical reference for the government and companies.

articleTitle: Data analysis of traditional summative assessment and continuous assessment-Engineering Science Departments case study
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE International Conference of Safety Produce Informatization (IICSPI)
abstract: Comparing with the traditional summative assessment, the continuous assessment is a minor assessment method in universities around the world. In the Faculty of Engineering and the Built Environment, University of Johannesburg, South Africa, the Department of Electrical Engineering Science applied the continuous assessment in the past five years in order to achieve better study performance while the Departments of Mechanical Engineering Science and Civil Engineering Science are still using the traditional summative assessment. It is necessary to analyse the performance of these two different assessment methods to find which method is better or more stable. In this paper, the traditional summative assessment and the continuous assessment are investigated and compared based on the pass rate of the modules/subjects of these three departments. The histograms and Wilcoxon signed-rank test are used to analyse the differences of these two assessment methods. From the statistical results of this case study, the pass rate of the traditional summative assessment is more stable than the continuous assessment. Finally the unexpected performance of the continuous assessment is investigated.

articleTitle: Hidden Wi-Fi Auto-connecting System Based on Android ROM-Level
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE International Conference of Safety Produce Informatization (IICSPI)
abstract: This paper presents a method for the realization of hidden Wi-Fi auto-connect system based on android ROM-Level. Under this system, two Android devices can establish a Wi-Fi connection at a specific time, and do not display a Wi-Fi icon when the connection is successfully established. Among them, write the program of BroadcastReceiver in the Android framework layer to realize the control and management of Wi-Fi module, modify Android native calculator program to achieve user configuration function, and modify system application of SystemUI to realize the function of shielding Wi-Fi icon. Since the code is written based on the ROM-Level and the entire process is user-insensitive, the system maintains a high security and can provide new application scenarios.

articleTitle: Research on the Key Technology of Ship VHFDSC Wireless Communication Network
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE International Conference of Safety Produce Informatization (IICSPI)
abstract: Sea transport occupies a very important position in human life. In recent years, due to the increase of traffic volume of vessels, the increase of transportation tonnage and the increase of ship speed have made the water transport environment more crowded and dangerous. Ship traffic safety is the first problem. The shadow of the sea condition and the topography must exist in many blind areas. It cannot be fully covered, and it is difficult to contact the ship with distress and handle the alarm of the ship. The ship's safety information cannot be reported to the shore in a timely and reliable manner, and the so-called coordinated search and rescue cannot be realized effectively. Therefore, this paper proposes a design scheme for the establishment of VHFDSC regional network, which can realize the complete seamless coverage of offshore busy waterway and port area ship safety information, so as to ensure the safety of navigation.

articleTitle: Analysis on Forming Defects of Automobile Drawing Parts and Adjustment Measures of Mold
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE International Conference of Safety Produce Informatization (IICSPI)
abstract: The size accuracy and surface quality directly affect the quality of the car, and the main factors affecting the quality of drawing parts are cracking, wrinkling, rebound, etc. This paper studies from stamping process to mold design. The wrinkling and cracking problem of automobile drawing parts during drawing were analyzed. From the aspects of process, design and adjustment, the deep drawing cracking and wrinkling of parts and the adjustment measures are studied in detail. Experiments proved the effectiveness of the methods and measures proposed in this paper.

articleTitle: Software Anti-Interference Technology of Single Chip Microcomputer Control System
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE International Conference of Safety Produce Informatization (IICSPI)
abstract: There are plenty of interference sources in the operation of the single-chip microcomputer control system, which will affect the operation of the system. This paper mainly discusses advantages and disadvantages of the mainstream software in anti-jamming technique, and analyzes the disadvantages of the existing software anti-jam anti-jamming technique using the combination of the C language and other several assembly languages for its improvement. The application of the software anti-jamming technique has improved the reliability of the control system effectively and saved the system computing time, resulting in its wide application.

articleTitle: Application of Alarm Information Statistical Analysis Based on Protection and Fault Information System
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE International Conference of Safety Produce Informatization (IICSPI)
abstract: The processing of the warning information by the traditional protection and fault information system is only a simple accumulation of a large number of alarm information, without in-depth analysis and utilization. The article is extended to model the alarm information of the protection device, and classifying the alarm information in detail and accurately, forming a knowledge base of alarm information. On this basis, the information is guaranteed. The alarm information received by the protection and fault information system is analyzed online, so as to realize the status monitoring, diagnosis and maintenance decision of the secondary equipment, and support the operation and maintenance of the secondary equipment.

Author Keywords: the secondary operation and maintenance of equipment

articleTitle: An Application of Agent-based Multi-Objective Genetic Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE International Conference of Safety Produce Informatization (IICSPI)
abstract: An Improved Agent-Based Genetic Algorithm is used to solve the multi-objective Network Optimization Problems. The Agent is used to the genetic algorithm and the specific encoding is used to encode the path of network. The Pareto competition classic ordering method is used for the calculation of Agent energy. The partial mapping crossover is used to deal with the conflict of genes in crossover process. Comparative experiments show that the algorithm is efficient when is used to solve network multi-objective optimization problems.

articleTitle: Analog Skeletal Muscle Drive Model Based on Digital Hydraulic Technology
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE International Conference of Safety Produce Informatization (IICSPI)
abstract: In order to improve the performance and efficiency of the drive system, the skeletal muscle driving mechanism was studied in this paper by using animal skeletal muscle as bionic object. Based on the deep analysis of the microstructure and sliding mechanism of skeletal muscle, the hierarchical structure and drive mode of skeletal muscle were simplified, the digital hydraulic drive model of analog skeletal muscle was established, and the principle of skeletal driving based on digital hydraulic technology was analyzed. Consequently, a method of analog skeletal muscle drive system based on digital hydraulic was proposed, and the required flow and energy efficiency were analyzed and simulated. The results show that the digital hydraulic drive system of analog skeletal muscle can reduce the system flow and improve the energy efficiency compared with the traditional hydraulic system.

articleTitle: Design and Control of Small Mobile Phone Automatic Film Pasting Machine
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE International Conference of Safety Produce Informatization (IICSPI)
abstract: Aiming at the following problems, low efficiency of manual film, easy to produce bubbles and irregular, the small semi-automatic pasting machine is inconvenient, the large automatic pasting machine is expensive, a new automatic film pasting machine for mobile phone is put forward. The automatic film pasting machine is mainly composed of clamping, driving, cleaning, positioning and foil, it can remove implementation the functions of mobile phone screen cleaning, remove protective layer, automatically align the mobile phone screen and film. The power system is driven by a stepping motor, and the automatic control of the stepping motor is realized by AT89C51 single chip. The driving circuit of the stepping motor is composed of ULN2003. The display screen selects 8*8 LED display screen, and gives the display control circuit based on 51 single chip microcomputer. The result shows that the automatic film pasting machine achieves the preset functional requirements, the structure is simple, and the film holding efficiency is improved.

articleTitle: An improved standard humidity generator based on bubbling sulfuric acid
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE International Conference of Safety Produce Informatization (IICSPI)
abstract: In modern industrial production, controlling the water content in the environment is extremely important. With a large number of trace moisture detector was widely used, there is an urgent need for a reliable device for calibrating trace moisture analyzers. Conventional standard humidity generators used for calibration are too complicated and expensive to calibrate field devices. A portable device for preparing a trace amount of water based on the method of the saturation partial pressure of sulfuric acid is introduced in this paper. The principle of this device is that when the sulfuric acid at different temperatures and concentrations, the equilibrium water vapor pressure is different and remains constant to produce a constant concentration of trace gas, which can calibrate the trace moisture detector. In order to prevent the infiltration of external moisture, and to adapt to the corrosive environment of the chemical industry, gas piping and valves inside the device are made of metal pipe or Teflon material. The temperature control system inside the device can control the error within the range of about ± 0.1 degrees Celsius. After the experimental test, the error range of the instrument is ± 5 percent, when the calibrating gas is greater than 100 umol/mol. Which can meet the vast majority of moisture detector calibration and well adapt to the complex environment. The instrument has high reliability, simple structure and low cost, which is suitable for widely used and popularized. In addition, the instrument has expanded the function of the instrument combining Zigbee wireless communication technology and Internet of things technology. Meanwhile, detailed principle and structure of the improved standard humidity generator based on sulfuric acid bubbling method was introduced in this paper.

articleTitle: An Attribute Reduction Based on Genetic Algorithm and Rough Sets
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE International Conference of Safety Produce Informatization (IICSPI)
abstract: To solve the problem that low efficiency and slow convergence speed of traditional attribute reduction algorithm, we propose an attribute reduction algorithm which based on the genetic algorithm and rough sets. To obtain the minimum attribute reduction, attribute dependence and hamming distance as constrains is introduced in population initialization. When the fitness function is designed, the average attribute importance is introduced as the correction factor, and the fitness function is dynamically adjusted. The improved adaptive crossover and mutation probability are adopted, and in the cross-operation, a small-scale competition strategy is used. Experimental results prove the efficiency of the proposed algorithm in attribute reduction for high dimensionality and big data.

articleTitle: Research on the evaluation model of input and output benefit of enterprise distribution network based on fuzzy membership
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE International Conference of Safety Produce Informatization (IICSPI)
abstract: Based on the reform of power system, this paper establishes an indicator system for the evaluation of input and output efficiency of distribution network based on the integration of distribution and financing, and builds the evaluation model of the input and output efficiency based on the fuzzy membership degree, extract the data of the pilot units, conduct model trial calculations, optimize the model, and assist the performance appraisal of each unit, ensuring the efficiency of grid investment efficiency, strengthening precision investment, realizing investment must be effective, and inefficiency requires accountability.

articleTitle: Study on a Large-number of Heterogeneous Aeronautical Information Publication Collection Mechanism
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE International Conference of Safety Produce Informatization (IICSPI)
abstract: Aeronautical information publication is an important aspect to ensure the safe operation of modern civil aviation. Aeronautical information publication has the characteristics of large-number, heterogeneous and update irregularity. This paper study the collection mechanism of a large-number of heterogeneous aeronautical information publication. The model of aeronautical information publication collection is established, and the aeronautical information publication in a large-number of heterogeneous data sources is converted into uniform format for management. It provides data support for aeronautical information publication services, navigation data coding and flight plan management services.

articleTitle: Multimedia Broadcast System Based on Embedded Platform
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE International Conference of Safety Produce Informatization (IICSPI)
abstract: An embedded system is a specialized computer system which centers on application based on computer technology. Besides, this application system has strict demands for function, reliability, cost, memory management and power consumption. Moreover, its software and hardware can be cut. In recent years, the embedded system has developed rapidly. This paper is based on embedded hardware platform and the mainstream embedded operating system (Android) to realize common audio and video formats media player which has many functions, such as pause, play, single cycle, the whole circulation, progress bar and so on. At the same time, the perfect combination of view pager+fragment in activity can optimize the program design, increase the fluency and readability of software running.

articleTitle: Key Technology Research of Distribution Automation System Based on Cloud Architecture
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE International Conference of Safety Produce Informatization (IICSPI)
abstract: China's economic development has higher requirements for the power supply capability and reliability of distribution network. At present, the management scope of distribution automation system cannot cover the whole distribution network and many regional electric companies cannot manage the operation state of distribution network through the existing distribution automation system, which restricts the development of distribution network construction. It is necessary to develop a new system construction scheme to cope with the different data capacity and function requirements of distribution networks in different cities. This paper proposes a technical scheme of main station of distribution automation system based on cloud architecture in aspects of system architecture, elastic data processing, safe access of distribution terminals and optimal operation control. With the distributed collaboration between core cloud and regional cloud as well as data fragmentation parallel processing technology, the problem of massive access and application of distribution network will be solved.

articleTitle: Research on Safety Assessment of Military ATC system Based on Fuzzy Matter-element Model
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE International Conference of Safety Produce Informatization (IICSPI)
abstract: In order to assure the safety operation of military ATC system, on the basis of fuzzy matter-element analysis theory, a safety assessment model of military ATC system is proposed on the basis of safety assessment index system of military ATC system. The example analysis result shows that the assessment result basically reflects the actual safety level of the of military ATC system, providing a new way for military ATC safety assessment.

articleTitle: Satellite Link Analysis and Calculation Software Design
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE International Conference of Safety Produce Informatization (IICSPI)
abstract: Satellite communication system is a typical digital communication system whose communication reliability index is ultimately determined by the system error rate. In the codec mode, modulation and demodulation system components are used to determine the link carrier to noise ratio to determine the system's bit error rate. This paper first gives the threshold of the system carrier to noise ratio and link parameters calculation method, the use of Visual Studio independent development of link calculation software, link calculation, then it calculates a satellite communication system link margin.

articleTitle: Authentication Technology of Mobile Internet of Things Based on the Dynamic Password
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE International Conference of Safety Produce Informatization (IICSPI)
abstract: After describing the security issues that RFID authentication technology encounters at large, this paper proposes a RFID mutual authentication technology to resolve fake attacks, heavy attacks and other security issues and describes the Authentication Technology. The method refers to tags privacy level between tag and reader to achieve mutual authentication, which cannot only enhance the privacy protection of the label carrier and protect the identity privacy of the reader holder, but has effectiveness in some degree.

articleTitle: Research on Electrical Fault Injection Experiments of Hybrid Electric Vehicle Controller
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE International Conference of Safety Produce Informatization (IICSPI)
abstract: This paper analyses the possible electrical fault of the parallel-series hybrid electric vehicle controller's pedal and shift signal, establishes the hardware in the loop test platform for electrical fault injection into the vehicle controller, using the sensor fault injection card to simulate the related electrical fault of pedal and shift to find the fault processing strategy corresponding to the vehicle controller, and then compared with the expected failure handling strategies, results demonstrate that the controller can meet the design requirements, the test platform can be effectively used for the development testing of the hybrid electric vehicle controller.

articleTitle: Methods of Resource Allocation with Conflict Detection
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE International Conference of Safety Produce Informatization (IICSPI)
abstract: The problems of resource allocation in query-applying pattern widely exist in daily applications. Resource allocation has the characteristic of exclusiveness. Lock methods are mostly used to deal with possible conflicts in the allocation process in traditional solutions. There is a natural contradiction between lock mechanism and multi task parallelism and such contradiction becomes more and more protruding with the increasing popularity of parallel processing environments represented by multi core CPU. A method of abandoning lock mechanism at application level is discussed in this paper. Instead, the method of resource conflict detection is used to ensure the correctness of transaction parallelism. According to sufficient conditions for the effectiveness of conflict detection, two kinds of conflict detection algorithms are proposed, which are separately based on the queue and on Key-T table. Then, the problem of resource allocation is further extended to "renting" situation with "time dimension", where a more general conflict detection algorithm is proposed. The parallel efficiency of multi task system can be improved remarkably and the implementation of the system can be much simplified with the scheme based on conflict detection.

articleTitle: Research on Automatic Anti - skidding Technology of Vehicle Ice-snow Area
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE International Conference of Safety Produce Informatization (IICSPI)
abstract: This paper introduces the research status of the new technology of vehicle anti-skid technology at home and abroad, and designs a new type of snow-ice automatic snow chain on the 4x2 truck. The anti-skid device meets the longitudinal anti-skid requirements and drives attachment conditions of the vehicle when climbing on the ice and snow road with a great resistance to lateral forces of less than maximum lateral force of 32kN and a strong anti-skid ability.

articleTitle: Econometric Modelling for Missing Weather Variables Estimation: Shinyanga Region of Tanzania
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE International Conference of Safety Produce Informatization (IICSPI)
abstract: This study was conducted to develop econometric models for weather variables for Shinyanga region of Tanzania. The developed models used to predict missing weather variables such as sunshine, maximum, and minimum temperatures from 1981 to 1987. The authors used weather time series data including rainfall, sunshine, maximum, and minimum temperatures from 1981 to 2017 to establish statistical relationship among variables from Mbeya and Shinyanga regions. Various statistical methods used include Ordinary Least Square regression, Augmented Dickey-Fuller test for Unit root test of time series stationarity, Johansen Cointegration test and error correction to establish relationship among variables. We developed three econometric models for missing sunshine, maximum and minimum variables for Shinyanga region. Sunshine model shows that for each unit rainfall (mm) increase in Mbeya region increased the sunshine for Shinyanga by 3.8%, while for each increase in lmm rainfall in Shinyanga region the sunshine decreases by 1%. Maximum temperature model reveals that increase in rainfall in Mbeya by lmm decreases the maximum temperature by 0.5 % while for each increase by lmm rainfall in Shinyanga leads to a decrease of maximum temperature by 0.7%. For the minimum temperature model, 1 mm increase in both Mbeya and Shinyanga rainfall decreases the minimum temperature for Shinyanga by 0.4 % while increase in 1°C minimum temperature for Mbeya region increases Shinyanga minimum temperature by 43%. Accordingly, we estimated the missing variables by the use of the respective constructed models.

articleTitle: Design and Research of Junior High School Physics Micro-Course Based on Knowledge Map
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE International Conference of Safety Produce Informatization (IICSPI)
abstract: Nowadays, mobile learning has become the main way for students to learn autonomously, and micro-course plays an important role in mobile learning. Physics is an important course in junior high school, since it involves a large number of calculation formulas and concepts, micro-course can be used to make students understand the knowledge more intuitively and quickly. Based on the features of knowledge map, this paper proposes to design the physics micro lesson in junior high school based on the knowledge map, which aims to provide students with good knowledge navigation and improve their learning efficiency.

articleTitle: Application and Display of Hyperbolic Paraboloid
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE International Conference of Safety Produce Informatization (IICSPI)
abstract: the hyperbolic paraboloid is a kind of quadric surface and ruled surface. In this paper, we take the generation process of the rotating surface as introduction. Then we select multiple sets of parallel planes to intercept the hyperbolic paraboloid based on use the cross section method, and then discuss the graph and drawing method of the hyperbolic paraboloid. Meanwhile, we certified the ruled surface features by simulating the dynamic generation process. When the hyperbolic parabolic thin shell is used as the roof, it has the advantages of beautiful shape, good force performance and easy construction. So it has wide application in engineering construction. We explore the shape of the roof of Xinghai Concert Hall by analyzing the plane truncation. Finally, we use MATLAB to simulate its dynamic construction process.

articleTitle: A Research of Character Recognition Based on Residual Neural Network
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE International Conference of Safety Produce Informatization (IICSPI)
abstract: Aiming at the problem of video person recognition, this paper analyzes current technical environment and current technical problems, and designs a set of character recognition model based on residual neural network. It extracts key frames, locates characters, extracts characters of video and makes similar features with target characters. Comparison, to determine the identity of the person, and to explore the practicality of the model, through experiments, the identity of the person has achieved very good experimental results.

articleTitle: M-band Wavelet Kernels for Classical and Quantum SVM
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE International Conference of Safety Produce Informatization (IICSPI)
abstract: In this research, brand-new M-Band Wavelet Kernels within both classical and quantum environments are constructed for corresponding Support Vector Machines (SVM). Unlike kernels such as Gaussian RBF, our wavelet kernels in the classical case map the input space into a finite dimensional feature space of dimension 0(K<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">N</sup>), where K is the M-Band Wavelet compact support constant and N is the dimension of the input space. However, the kernel expression is simplified under quantum environment so that the quantum wavelet kernel will map the same input space to the feature space of dimension 0(K) only. Moreover, it is assumed there are P training points, then the complexity upon the training data comes to 0(Nlog P). Compared with the classical method of complexity being 0(P<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sup>K<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">N</sup>), there is an exponential speedup.

articleTitle: Automatic Acquiring of Chinese Semantic Relations Based on Knowledge Corpus
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE International Conference of Safety Produce Informatization (IICSPI)
abstract: Semantic relations play an important role in natural semantic understanding. The sentiment Semantic Dictionary is the basis of sentiment analysis research. This paper uses Modern Chinese Dictionary and baidu interpretation from the Internet as the knowledge corpus. By analyzing the knowledge structure of the corpus, we define different rules to automatically extract the semantic relationship of emotional words. The concept of fine - grained division of emotional intensity and semantic similarity is introduced. The emotional similarity is divided into four levels based on different rules. The dictionary of negative words and degree adverbs are constructed and the degree of adverbs is divided into different levels. The degree of adverbs and negative words in front of the emotional words are used to determine the strength of the emotional words. The method of random selection and manual verification is used for evaluation. The accuracy of synonymous relationship is over 90%, and the availability is high. There is almost no error in the emotional strength relationship, but due to rule restrictions, there are few words that extract intensity levels.

articleTitle: An Improve Group Anti-collision Algorithm based on Query Tree for RFID
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE International Conference of Safety Produce Informatization (IICSPI)
abstract: Tag collision avoidance is critical to the success of data communications in radio frequency identification (RID) system. Many classic algorithms are similar to QT, CTT, etc., and cannot meet the needs of higher and higher parameters. So based on QT and CTT, we propose an improve group anticollision algorithm(IGQT) to improve the performance of RFID system. First, we compare the algorithmic processes in QT and CTT, and compare and analyze the pros and cons of the two algorithms. Then, we reduce the number of slots and reduces the number of queries based on the QT and CTT algorithm, final, compare the system throughput and number of slots of QT, CTT, and IGQT algorithms. Experiment shows, the IGQT algorithm outperforms the existing proposed algorithms and greatly improves the recognition rate of the entire system.

articleTitle: An Analysis on Household Expenditure in Rural Cambodia Extended Linear Expenditure System Model (ELES)
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE International Conference of Safety Produce Informatization (IICSPI)
abstract: This study aims to estimate the parameters of an Extend linear expenditure system (ELES) demand function, including elasticities of expenditure, own-price, and cross-price elasticities. It further examines the household demand consumption in a rural Cambodia, using the 2017 household survey data conducted in three provinces of Cambodia namely; Takeo, Kandal and Kompong Speu. We randomly selected 240 farmers based on the regulation and sample distribution. The results show that, with regard to the estimation, own-price elasticities are comparatively inelastic demand for all commodities. On the other hand, findings show that income elasticity is positive in sign. The equipment has the highest income elasticity 10.374, which indicates that the equipment is a necessary commodity. These results reflect the higher income elasticities for all commodities, signifying that the commodity's demand will increase with increasing income.

articleTitle: Robustness analysis of neutral BAMNN with time delays
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE International Conference of Safety Produce Informatization (IICSPI)
abstract: This paper is studied with robustness of neutral BAMNN (Bidirectional Associative Memory neural networks) with time delays. We discuss that how much neutral term contraction coefficient and time delay are allowed to ensure the global exponential stable of neutral BAMNN with time delays. By using some transcendental equations, a criterion of global exponential stable is derived for neutral BAMNN with time delays. We proved in theory, if contraction coefficient of neutral terms and time delays are smaller than the results arrived, then the BAMNN also is globally exponentially stable. Finally, an example is provided to show the correctness of our analysis and the effectiveness of the theoretical results.

articleTitle: Application of Power Grid Communication Operation and Maintenance Knowledge Base Based on Self-learning Technology
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE International Conference of Safety Produce Informatization (IICSPI)
abstract: With the continuous development of information technology, applying automatic learning and self-learning methods such as machine learning and neural networks to the knowledge acquisition process of the knowledge base, becomes the trend and direction of the current knowledge base development. This paper describes the development of the self-learning knowledge base and technical methods, and practices the whole process of the database construction, neural network construction, neural network training process, experimental application of self-learning knowledge base, achieves the desired goal. It lays the foundation for the construction and practice of the self learning knowledge base in the broader knowledge field.

articleTitle: Optimal Fractional-order PID Control of Permanent Magnetic Synchronous Generator for Fault-ride Through Enhancement using Yin-Yang Pair Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE International Conference of Safety Produce Informatization (IICSPI)
abstract: Wind energy conversion system (WECS) plays an important role in renewable energy generation for the sake of environment protection and reduction of greenhouse gas emission. This paper designs a novel optimal fractional-order PID control (FPID) scheme of permanent magnetic synchronous generator (PMSG) to enhance the fault-ride through (FRT) capability, which aims to considerably increase the operation reliability of PMSG under various grid fault scenarios. An ancient Chinese philosophy inspired meta-heuristic algorithm, called Yin-Yang pair algorithm (YYPA), is employed to optimally tune the control parameters of FPID. YYPA has a very simple structure with few parameters that need to be tuned, thus it is very easy to be implemented with efficient optimum searching ability. Moreover, due to the use of fractional-order mechanism, the closed-loop system dynamics could be further improved, such that a satisfactory FRT performance of PMSG can be achieved. Case studies verify the effectiveness and superiority of YYPA compared to that of genetic algorithm (GA) and particle swarm optimization (PSO).

articleTitle: Ensemble Machine Learning Identification of Power Fault Countermeasure Text Considering Word String TF-IDF Feature
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE International Conference of Safety Produce Informatization (IICSPI)
abstract: A large amount of fault countermeasure texts are used to guide fault handing operations in power dispatching systems. This paper transforms the identification problem of fault countermeasure disposal text into a classification problem for identifying the content of text, understanding the meaning of text and building an intelligent power grid fault handling automation system. Firstly, the characteristics of fault countermeasure text are analyzed, and the text is preprocessed according to the characteristics and classification requirements. (Term Frequency-Inverse Document Frequency) TF-IDF is used to analyze and extract and vectorize the features of words and word strings in text, then concatenated feature vectors are used to vectorize the text. classification models are built based on a variety of machine learning methods. Examples show that the feature extraction method taking TF-IDF of word string into consideration is superior to word TF-IDF, and the classification effects of different machine learning methods are compared. The examples also show that the ensemble machine learning classification model has better classification effect than the single classifier, and can identify the text of fault countermeasure disposal more accurately and efficiently.

articleTitle: A systemic approach to hazard analysis and control based on energy function
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE International Conference of Safety Produce Informatization (IICSPI)
abstract: The hazard analysis and control is one of the most significant issues of the safety management process. The paper proposes a new approach to systemically identify and analyze multi-hazards. The energy function was first studied, summing up the energies involved in production and lives of the national economy with a unified function. Relationships between common production accidents and corresponding energies was presented. In order to take measures in emergency rescue based on energy change, four properties of energy, storability, additivity, transitivity and transformability, were analyzed. The method provide guidance for hazard identification and prevention, and it is proved by guiding the hazard identification of coal mine and carry out effective measures to prevent occurrence of disaster. It indicates that the proposed approach propose a systemic method to analyze multiple hazards and reduce risk of abnormal energy transfer.

articleTitle: Research on Key Technology of Emergency Communication System in Post-Earthquake Disaster Relief
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE International Conference of Safety Produce Informatization (IICSPI)
abstract: In recent years the previous global earthquake, the earthquake relief and gold 72 hours in the first place, but the communication and network environment in the earthquake stricken area is very complex, the conventional network access mode at the time of the disaster is very difficult to guarantee the site and command decision-making departments of real time data transmission and communication. According to a serious destructive earthquake occurred in recent years, especially in Wenchuan, Yushu earthquake rescue and post disaster damage, according to the specific situation of earthquake field communication, as well as the earthquake rescue scene network communication needs, to ensure the communication system of earthquake field can smooth, ensure the communication between the front and rear decision Department of non-clogging problems, research on earthquake emergency communication system, and put forward their own views and opinions.

articleTitle: Current Situation of Multimodal Corpora and the Method of Tibetan Corpus Construction
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE International Conference of Safety Produce Informatization (IICSPI)
abstract: In recent years, the rapid development of artificial intelligence has brought enormous influence to the human social life, and as part of artificial intelligence, affective computing is attracting more and more attention from researchers because it can be applied to many fields such as psychology, sociology and so on. Human beings will express emotion through expression, voice, text and physiological signals, and the development of emotional computing cannot be separated from the support of emotional database. At present, the emotional database is mostly single modality, and there are many deficiencies in the existing multimodal emotion database. Therefore, it is of great significance to construct a more fully prepared multimodal emotion database. This paper summarizes the research status of multimodal corpus in China and abroad, and constructs a more comprehensive Tibetan multimodal emotion corpus.

articleTitle: The Impact of Labor Input on Crop Yield and Price in China
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE International Conference of Safety Produce Informatization (IICSPI)
abstract: this article intend to measure the impact of labor input on crop yield and price in China, based on the complex economic background, such as China agricultural price increasing. All the data in this article is from National Agricultural Product Cost Data Compilation (1990-2016), including 13 agricultural products. The authors have tested the time series stability of labor cost in unit weight of agricultural product, cost price, producer price; and we analyze the relationship between labor price and producer price. The results show that there is the stationary relation between labor cost in unit weight of agricultural product and cost price, but also it is stationary between the agricultural cost price and producer price or agricultural purchase price. Based on the results, through derivation, the author found that the agricultural producer price and the labor price are directly relative. Thus would provide a new method for government to estimate agricultural purchase price, in the same time, the authors give some suggestion on the relevant policies of agricultural producer price determining and the labor price policy, such as the salary management, etc..
